findings.summary: The mandatory adversarial-review approval gate is still pending and the review artifact remains templated.

The current plan-description still records review status as pending, while adversarial-review.md contains placeholder scope text and a pending verdict.

planning/SKILL.md lines 397-409 require synchronized approved review status and state pending or mismatched status is rejected.
adversarial-review.md lines 5-7 contain placeholder review scope fields.

findings.required_correction: Complete a fresh independent adversarial review artifact with non-placeholder scope, resolved findings if any, an approved verdict if warranted, and synchronize the plan-description review status only after that approval exists.

findings.summary: The benchmark report is not final and does not satisfy required report evidence.

The current report leaves end timestamp and elapsed time pending, leaves token usage pending rather than unavailable, does not record a revision, and says final validation output is recorded in validation.md even though no validation.md exists in the plan directory.
